layers.name: Layer 1: Core Command Tree, Lifecycle & Helpers
layers.responsibility: Defines the composite Command tree node, flag set inheritance (pflag), subcommand lookup (Find/Traverse/stripFlags), ExecuteC hook orchestration, template rendering, and OS-specific pre-exec hooks.

layers.name: Layer 2: Argument Validators & Relational Flag Groups
layers.responsibility: Provides composable positional argument validators (NoArgs, ExactArgs, RangeArgs, MatchAll, OnlyValidArgs) and relational flag group enforcement (RequiredTogether, OneRequired, MutuallyExclusive).

layers.name: Layer 3: Shell Completion V2 Engine & Shell Script Generators
layers.responsibility: Implements the hidden __complete / __completeNoDesc subcommand protocol, ShellCompDirective bitmasks, ActiveHelp hints, and shell-specific completion script generators for Bash (V1/V2), Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell.

layers.name: Layer 4: Documentation Generation Subpackage (cobra/doc)
layers.responsibility: Walks a configured Command tree to emit static CLI reference documentation in Markdown, roff Man pages, ReStructuredText, and YAML formats without touching core runtime execution.

execution_flows.name: CLI Command Resolution & Hook Execution Pipeline
execution_flows.trigger: Application main() invokes rootCmd.Execute() or rootCmd.ExecuteContext(ctx)
steps: Command.ExecuteContext binds ctx to rootCmd and delegates to Command.ExecuteC()

Command.ExecuteC() initializes default help/version/completion commands (initCompleteCmd, InitDefaultCompletionCmd, InitDefaultHelpCmd) and resolves os.Args[1:] via Command.Find() or Command.Traverse()
Command.Find() strips flags via stripFlags() at each level of the tree to locate the target leaf Command and remaining positional/flag tokens
Command.execute() merges inherited persistent flags (mergePersistentFlags), parses pflag sets (ParseFlags), and runs OnInitialize callbacks

Command.ValidateRequiredFlags() and Command.ValidateFlagGroups() verify required flags and relational groups (RequiredTogether, OneRequired, MutuallyExclusive), followed by PositionalArgs validation (ValidateArgs)

Lifecycle hooks run in strict order: ancestor PersistentPreRunE/PersistentPreRun -> local PreRunE/PreRun -> RunE/Run -> local PostRunE/PostRun -> ancestor PersistentPostRunE/PersistentPostRun -> OnFinalize callbacks

execution_flows.name: Dynamic Shell Completion V2 Protocol (__complete / __completeNoDesc)
execution_flows.trigger: Interactive shell TAB press invokes `<binary> __complete [args...]` generated by Bash/Zsh/Fish/PowerShell completion script
steps: Command.initCompleteCmd registers the hidden __complete and __completeNoDesc subcommands on the root Command
When invoked, __complete calls Command.getCompletions(args) to parse partial flags/arguments without executing RunE hooks

checkIfFlagCompletion detects if the cursor is completing a flag name or flag value, looking up registered CompletionFunc in flagCompletionFunctions (protected by flagCompletionMutex) or flag annotations
For positional arguments, getCompletions merges persistent flags, enforces flag groups for completion (enforceFlagGroupsForCompletion), and invokes ValidArgsFunction or static ValidArgs

AppendActiveHelp appends _activeHelp_ prefixed hints if configured, and __complete prints candidate lines to stdout followed by `:<ShellCompDirective>` bitmask (e.g., :4 for ShellCompDirectiveNoFileComp) and diagnostics to stderr

execution_flows.name: Static Multi-Format Documentation Tree Synthesis
execution_flows.trigger: Build tool calls doc.GenMarkdownTree, doc.GenManTree, doc.GenReSTTree, or doc.GenYamlTree on root Command
steps: Tree walker recursively visits visible child commands (skipping Hidden or unavailable commands) and calls InitDefaultHelpCmd / InitDefaultHelpFlag
Per-command formatter extracts Use, Short, Long, Example, local non-inherited flags, and inherited persistent flags
Cross-reference links to parent and child commands are sorted and rendered via text/buffer writers (and go-md2man/v2 for roff man pages or yaml/v3 for YAML)

state_and_storage: In-memory tree of Command structs holding parent/children pointers, pflag.FlagSet instances (flags, pflags, lflags, inheritedFlags), and annotations map[string]string
Thread-safe global flag completion registry (flagCompletionFunctions map[*pflag.Flag]CompletionFunc guarded by sync.RWMutex flagCompletionMutex in completions.go)
Package-level lifecycle slices (initializers, finalizers) and template function registry (templateFuncs) in cobra.go
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: RunE/PreRunE/PostRunE hooks and PositionalArgs/FlagGroup validators propagate standard Go `error` values up through ExecuteC() (with optional SilenceErrors and SilenceUsage flags on Command). Context cancellation propagates via Command.Context() set by ExecuteContext(ctx). Flag completion registration is synchronized via sync.RWMutex (flagCompletionMutex).

audit_dimensions.title: Interpret Go AST Facts & Evaluate Quality/Typing/Error-Handling/Security
audit_dimensions.summary: Deterministic Go AST analysis across 19 production files (4,888 LOC, 17 types, 269 functions) confirms 100.0% import hygiene, 98.4% GoDoc coverage (173/176 exported symbols), 94.1% type safety coverage, zero circular dependencies, zero hardcoded secrets, and zero CWE command/SQL/path sinks. Minor maintainability and quality focal points include high cognitive complexity in core dispatchers (Command.getCompletions cognitive=96, Command.execute cognitive=66, defaultUsageFunc cognitive=47, Command.enforceFlagGroupsForCompletion cognitive=37), 13 package-level mutable variables in cobra.go and completions.go, and configuration-time panic(...) assertions in Command.AddCommand and MarkFlags* helpers.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Go Module Build, Supply Chain & Dependencies
audit_dimensions.summary: spf13/cobra v1.10.2 exhibits a lean, well-pinned Go module structure (go.mod + go.sum) with only 4 direct dependencies (spf13/pflag v1.0.9, cpuguy83/go-md2man/v2 v2.0.6, inconshreveable/mousetrap v1.1.0, go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.4), zero unpinned requirements, zero committed secrets, and comprehensive README/LICENSE documentation. The go.mod directive remains at 'go 1.15' for broad backward compatibility across legacy Go consumers, and this standalone source snapshot omits upstream .github/workflows and SECURITY.md.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Public API Boundaries, Import Purity, SemVer & Diátaxis Docs
audit_dimensions.summary: Cobra v1.10.2 demonstrates strong reusable library hygiene: explicit exported vs package-private API boundaries across `cobra` and `cobra/doc`, zero network/file I/O side effects at package import time, MVS-compatible SemVer dependency declarations in `go.mod`, and 98.4% GoDoc coverage. Minor library hygiene notes include convenience helper `cobra.CheckErr` (which intentionally calls `os.Exit(1)` for CLI main() ergonomics) and `fmt.Println` inside `doc/yaml_docs.go:139` when `GenYamlCustom` encounters an error.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Go Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: Cobra v1.10.2 maintains a comprehensive, deterministic Go test suite across 17 `*_test.go` files containing 280 test functions and 100.0% module test alignment across both `cobra` and `cobra/doc`. Only 2 of 280 test functions were flagged as assertion-free by static AST inspection: `TestCalledAs` (`command_test.go:2477`, which delegates assertions to `tc.test` via `t.Run(name, tc.test)`) and `TestCompletionFuncCompatibility` (`completions_test.go:2896`, which performs a compile-time type-assignability check `var _ CompletionFunc = userComp` and does not assert the return value of `RegisterFlagCompletionFunc`).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Hermetic containerized runtime verification (`--network=none`, `.pni/dockerfiles/Dockerfile`, `golang:1.22-bookworm`, non-root `USER pni`) passed all 4 RV gates: clean container image build (`13.83s`), 100% offline `go vet ./...` and `go test -v -coverprofile=/out/coverage.out ./...` pass (`424/424` tests passed, `0` failed, `0` skipped in `7.03s`), `86.8%` measured statement coverage (`1,631 / 1,880` statements across `cobra` and `cobra/doc`), and clean `go build ./...` library compilation smoke probe (`0` exit code). Only thin wrapper methods in `zsh_completions.go` (`52.6%`), `bash_completionsV2.go` (`57.1%`), `cobra.go` (`59.4%`), and `powershell_completions.go` (`60.0%`) fall below 80% per-file statement coverage.

findings.description: Command.execute has a cognitive complexity of 66 across 141 lines as it coordinates flag parsing, help/version short-circuiting, flag-group validation, and the 5-stage PreRun/Run/PostRun hook chain.
findings.recommendation: Extract hook-chain execution (PersistentPreRunE..PersistentPostRunE) and pre-execution flag validation into dedicated private methods on Command.

findings.description: Command.getCompletions has a cognitive complexity of 96 across 267 lines, interleaving flag parsing, argument stripping, ValidArgsFunction invocation, and ActiveHelp synthesis.
findings.recommendation: Decompose Command.getCompletions into focused helper methods for flag completion resolution, positional argument completion, and directive post-processing.

findings.evidence: fmt.Println(err) before returning err in doc/yaml_docs.go:139
findings.description: GenYamlCustom writes `fmt.Println(err)` directly to standard output before returning the `yaml.Marshal` error, bypassing caller-controlled error handling.
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant `fmt.Println(err)` call in `GenYamlCustom` and simply return `err` to the caller.

findings.evidence: 13 mutable package-level variables in cobra.go and completions.go (EnablePrefixMatching, EnableCommandSorting, EnableCaseInsensitive, EnableTraverseRunHooks, templateFuncs, initializers, finalizers)
findings.description: Package-level mutable globals control parser behavior across the entire process, which can cause state bleed across parallel tests if mutated concurrently.
findings.recommendation: Prefer per-Command or per-root-tree configuration fields on Command struct over mutating package-level globals.

findings.description: go.mod specifies 'go 1.15' as the minimum language version directive rather than a modern supported Go 1.22+ toolchain.
findings.recommendation: Advance the go directive in go.mod to 'go 1.22' or 'go 1.23' in a future minor release once legacy toolchain support windows close.

findings.description: Three exported symbols lack leading GoDoc comments (out of 176 exported symbols, 98.4% coverage).
findings.recommendation: Add standard GoDoc comments to PositionalArgs, Command.ValidateArgs, and CompletionOptions.SetDefaultShellCompDirective to reach 100% GoDoc coverage.

findings.evidence: zsh_completions.go coverage=52.6% (10/19 statements, missing lines 25, 36, 55, 66, 70, 72, 75); bash_completionsV2.go coverage=57.1% (8/14 statements, missing lines 33, 470, 472, 475)
findings.description: File-writing completion wrapper methods (`GenZshCompletionFile`, `GenZshCompletionFileNoDesc`, `GenBashCompletionFileV2`, `GenPowerShellCompletionFile`) are not exercised by unit tests using `t.TempDir()`.
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests using `t.TempDir()` to exercise `GenZshCompletionFile`, `GenBashCompletionFileV2`, and `GenPowerShellCompletionFile`.

findings.description: TestCompletionFuncCompatibility verifies compile-time type compatibility of CompletionFunc signatures but discards the error returned by cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc("foo", userComp).
findings.recommendation: Assert `if err := cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc("foo", userComp); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }` after defining flag `--foo` on `cmd` so runtime registration is also verified.

action_plan.title: Decompose Command.getCompletions and Command.execute Hotspots
action_plan.action: Refactor Command.getCompletions (cognitive=96) and Command.execute (cognitive=66) into smaller single-responsibility helpers covering flag completion dispatch, argument validation, and hook-chain traversal.
action_plan.expected_impact: Reduces maximum method cognitive complexity below 30 and improves readability of the core CLI execution and completion engines.

action_plan.title: Remove Direct fmt.Println(err) Side Effect in doc/yaml_docs.go
action_plan.action: Delete `fmt.Println(err)` at line 139 of `doc/yaml_docs.go` so `GenYamlCustom` returns errors silently without writing to stdout.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates unexpected stdout noise when callers handle `GenYamlCustom` errors programmatically.

action_plan.title: Modernize go.mod Toolchain Directive to Go 1.22+
action_plan.action: Update the 'go 1.15' directive in go.mod to 'go 1.22' (or 'go 1.23') and run 'go mod tidy' to adopt modern module graph pruning.
action_plan.expected_impact: Enables Go 1.17+ lazy module loading, modern standard library generics/slices helpers, and explicit toolchain version tracking.

action_plan.title: Add GoDoc Comments to Remaining 3 Exported Symbols
action_plan.action: Add GoDoc comments to PositionalArgs (args.go:22), Command.ValidateArgs (command.go:1172), and CompletionOptions.SetDefaultShellCompDirective (completions.go:123).
action_plan.expected_impact: Raises exported GoDoc coverage from 98.4% to 100.0%.

action_plan.title: Add Explicit Runtime Assertion in TestCompletionFuncCompatibility
action_plan.action: Define `--foo` flag in `TestCompletionFuncCompatibility` and check the error returned by `cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc("foo", userComp)` via `t.Fatalf`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Combines compile-time signature verification with runtime flag completion registration assertion.

action_plan.title: Add t.TempDir() Unit Tests for Completion File Wrapper Methods
action_plan.action: Add table-driven tests using `t.TempDir()` for `GenZshCompletionFile`, `GenZshCompletionFileNoDesc`, `GenBashCompletionFileV2`, and `GenPowerShellCompletionFile`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Lifts per-file statement coverage in `zsh_completions.go`, `bash_completionsV2.go`, and `powershell_completions.go` above 85%.
